section.content: The embodiment of the present invention is related to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit.The semiconductor integrated circuit includes substrate, the first transistor and the first patterned conductive layer.The first transistor has source region in the substrate, drain region and area of grid on substrate.First patterned conductive layer is electrically connected to the drain region of the first transistor.First patterned conductive layer includes the first section, the second section and fusible device.
本发明的实施例涉及一种半导体集成电路。该半导体集成电路包括衬底、第一晶体管和第一图案化的导电层。第一晶体管具有在衬底中的源极区域、漏极区域以及在衬底上的栅极区域。第一图案化的导电层电连接至第一晶体管的漏极区域。第一图案化的导电层包括第一区段、第二区段和可熔器件。

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The embodiment of the present invention relates in general to semiconductor field, more particularly, to semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technique

In the developing stage of integrated circuit, control circuit (such as central processing unit (CPU) or microprocessor) is answered It is written into read-only memory (ROM) with program.Then, in the fabrication stage, manufacturing control circuit, the program is stored in ROM simultaneously In.ROM can be manufactured by masking, so that the data of record are limited by specific photoetching mask structure.In addition, each storage Unit is made of transistor.The binary data remembered in this element passed through in the implant operation phase for exhausting or enhancing Between masked or not masked true of transistor limit.Then, integrated circuit is tested.If the application of integrated circuit is Considerably complicated one kind is then easy to mistake occur in a program.In order to correct the mistake, manufacturing integrated circuit again may be to have Necessary, this includes the new procedures of control circuit and corrigendum.This means that using new one group of exposure mask, therefore cause relatively high Cost and interminable operation.

In order to provide the flexibility of IC design, random access memory (RAM) is answered for storage control circuit Use program.The mistake of application program can be corrected in RAM, and then corrected program can be sent to ROM to complete to integrate Circuit.Compared to ROM construction is changed, time and cost can be saved using additional RAM.However, additional RAM is inevitably Certain space or area can be occupied, which increase the sizes of integrated circuit.Furthermore, it is necessary to which additional peripheral circuit is to control or prop up Additional RAM is held, this complicates circuit design and power management.

RRAM is a kind of favored form of nonvolatile memory, with low-work voltage, high speed characteristics and good Durability.The storage unit of RRAM is by determining that the variation of the resistance of film (usually metal oxide film) is worked.In addition, electric Resistance corresponds to the information (for example, value of " 0 " or " 1 ") of storage.RRAM generally includes the array of this storage unit.RRAM device Storage unit include tool there are two electrode and the variable resistive material layer between two electrodes data storage elements. For applicability purpose, resistance variable memory can be described as programmable Conductive Random Access memory (PCRAM) Or phase change random access memory devices (PCRAM), have been investigated as half volatile and non-volatile RAM device. In PCRAM device, chalcogenide glass framework (chalcogenide glass backbone) can be programmed for stable Compared with low electric conductivity (that is, high electrical resistance) and high electrical conductivity (that is, compared with low resistance) state.Unprogrammed PCRAM device is usually located In more low electric conductivity or more high resistance state.
